label: Coverage, from reflexive access, no contingent support and no novel edge (inference)
rule: Direct: the supporter elsewhere is necessary by J1, exists at w by reflexive access, and its edge holds at w by no novel edge
meaning: Coverage is no stronger than the package of reflexive access at w, no contingent concrete support (J1) and the one-way no-novel-edge condition on the concrete subtype: the same supporter covers the target at w. It is strictly weaker: in the rooted-pair control coverage holds while the no-novel-edge condition fails. Conditional consequence only.
